delivery: Benjamin leads architecture, project delivery, review and acceptance; Sextant/AI builds software. No assumed software contractor labor. Specialist physical installation is a separately qualified field scope.

in_scope.software_platforms: Custom software development, web and mobile applications, APIs, SaaS products, enterprise platforms, workflow automation and systems integration.
in_scope.ai_ml: Artificial intelligence, machine learning, generative AI, RAG, intelligent agents, document intelligence and AI-assisted business processes.
in_scope.data: Database engineering, data platforms, ETL pipelines, data migration, analytics, business intelligence, data governance and reporting dashboards.
in_scope.security_cloud: Cybersecurity engineering, identity and access management, security automation, cloud architecture, DevOps, infrastructure automation and technology consulting.
in_scope.digital_content: Electronic content and records management, enterprise search, digital accessibility, learning software, application usability and software implementation.
in_scope.energy_integration: Hydrogen and new-energy infrastructure project leadership, technical systems integration, installation-team and subcontractor coordination, commissioning and overall project delivery. Physical installation is a separately scoped specialist responsibility.

out_of_scope.civil: Road construction, asphalt paving, concrete patching, excavation, drainage, sewer and water pipeline construction, bridge repair and civil earthwork.
out_of_scope.property: Real estate brokerage, property acquisition, leasing, landscaping, janitorial cleaning, grounds maintenance, window washing and building trades.
out_of_scope.goods: Supply and delivery of fleet vehicles, replacement machinery parts, office supplies, food, fuel, furniture, medical supplies and standalone equipment without software engineering or integration.
out_of_scope.lobbying: Legislative lobbying, government relations, political advocacy, bond underwriting, investment banking and legal representation.
out_of_scope.grants: Grant applications and capital-outlay funding requests for vehicles, meals and equipment rather than a procurement for technology services.
out_of_scope.events: Music performance, entertainment programming, event catering, food service, portable toilets, transport operations and staffing unrelated to technology delivery.
